verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents organizations and memberships as first-party data objects. The Auth0 migration imports users, organizations, memberships and roles, and RBAC supports organization-scoped roles enforced via session JWTs. Organizations can also carry custom metadata and be managed through the API, dashboard or MCP server. No evidence covers invitation flows, so that third element of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: any documented invitation flow, dedicated docs on the organization/membership model itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant modeling.
